description: One tool-failure / wrong-result / workaround report, filed as a single JSON file in state/feedback-inbox/ and harvested into state/feedback.jsonl. A record with no evidence pointer is rejected by the harvester, loudly.

error.description: The exact error text or observed behaviour, verbatim where available.

evidence.description: At least one pointer to evidence: a file:line, a log, or a capture. No pointer = rejected.

id.description: Stable unique record id. Re-harvesting the same id adds zero (idempotency key).

impact.description: blocked = the run could not proceed; worked_around = it proceeded by another route; friction = it proceeded, slower or worse.

kind.description: Failure class, e.g. tool_failure, wrong_result, workaround, stall.

request_ids.description: Optional: request/run IDs that lead back to the system of record.

status.description: Optional triage state, e.g. open, defence-landed. Written back by the tutor when a mechanism lands a defence; entries never vanish silently.

title.description: One-line statement of the problem, in plain words.

tool.description: The tool, skill, or route that failed or was worked around.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the failure was observed.

title: ai-tutor feedback record
